name: Protopasta Matte Fiber HTPLA
filament_notes:
Matte Fiber HTPLA, including the wood-tone colors. Material Data Table: 200C up to 12 mm3/s, 220C up to 18 mm3/s, 55C plate; avoid printing below 3 mm3/s. TDS: 195C nozzle, 60C bed. This profile uses 200C with an 18 mm3/s cap.
Rough on PTFE tubing - replace it more often. The TDS says this fiber does not need a wear-resistant nozzle. Heat treat like HTPLA (TDS: 95-110C, 10+ minutes).
